name: P0
description: Emergency: security bypass, data loss or unusable core functionality.

name: P1
description: High-priority user-facing failure or reliability risk.

name: P3
description: Polish, cleanup or a proposal with undecided scope.

name: bug
description: Confirmed or reported incorrect behavior; inspect review evidence.

name: validation
description: Runtime, integration or physical-device evidence is needed.

name: ux
description: User interaction, clarity or accessibility of the experience.

name: reliability
description: Delivery, persistence, recovery or sustained operation.

name: regression
description: Previously working behavior now fails; requires before/after evidence.

name: impact:ux-friction
description: Avoidable user confusion, repetition or support burden.

name: impact:ux-release-blocker
description: A normal user cannot proceed without technical recovery or support.

name: needs-info
description: Specific information is needed to investigate.

name: needs-product-decision
description: Requires a product scope or behavior decision.

name: tracking
description: Planning index spanning multiple issues; no single priority required.

name: triage:manual
description: Pause all automatic label changes for this issue.
